rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` has skill front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material. It requires each such link to say when to read the file.

The file has one Markdown link, the `[CI example](../habeas/references/ci.md)` link in workflow step 9. That step gives the occasion for using it: "Recommend separate successful collection and `habeas coverage-check` steps in project CI, using the Habeas CI example". So the link is tied to when to read it, which is when recommending CI steps.

The other references to supporting files are code spans, not links. Each of them also says when to read:
- `references/authoring-failures.md`: "If it fails, read…".
- `references/distributed-requirements.md`: "When a convention applies on its own at many sites… read…".
- `references/fixme.md`: given for the case where the user defers a fix.

No link lacks a when-to-read statement, so I found no gap.
